name: AbuseIPDB - Service Principal and Managed Identity Auth from Blacklisted IPs
description: Correlates AbuseIPDB blacklisted IPs specifically with Service Principal and Managed Identity sign-in logs. Detects non-human identity authentication from known abusive infrastructure, which may indicate compromised application credentials or API key theft.
query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
union
(AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| project TimeGenerated, Identity = ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, ResourceName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ServicePrincipal', AppId = tostring(ServicePrincipalId)),
(AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| project TimeGenerated, Identity = ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, ResourceName = ResourceDisplayName, ResultType, SignInType = 'ManagedIdentity', AppId = tostring(ServicePrincipalId))
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, Identity, IPAddress, AbuseScore, Country, ResourceName, ResultType, SignInType, AppId
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimeGenerated desc
